messages:
sam: FYI support ticket TKT-45678 — customer (acct-987) in DE reporting data-residency alerts + latency after automatic fallback moved them to us-west. They also reported a billing spike. Escalating for triage.
support-bot: New ticket created: TKT-45678 by @support-jane. Audit alert tag: cross-region-failover residency_policy_violation.
maria: Can you paste the audit log snippet here so we can confirm the region tags?
sam: audit snippet:
```
ops-audit: user_id=acct-987 region=eu-central1 attempted_fallback=us-west1 policy=latency_threshold exceeded=true residency_ok=false
event_ts=2027-09-03T12:04:22Z
audit_id=abc123
```
dinesh: If residency_ok=false then fallback should've been blocked. Which routing policy version was active? v1.2 had a known edge-case but it shouldn't violate residency for enterprise accounts.
laura: I repro'd quickly from a DE IP: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'X-Region: eu-central1' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
Result: 302 -> us-west1 then API returned RESIDENCY_VIOLATION and a 403 from policy check. Latency also increased.
sam: Customer error payload: {"code":"RESIDENCY_VIOLATION","message":"Request served from us-west1; customer policy: europe-only"}
maria: Ops dashboard shows fallback priority order set to: latency -> capacity -> residency for routing-policy v2.5. That ordering is wrong for customers with residency_required flag.
ops-bot: Routing policy rollout v2.5 started canary 2027-09-03T11:50Z. Config: allow_cross_region_failover=true for low-tier and default buckets. Affected accounts include acct-987 (matched by rule fallback:best_effort).
dinesh: Mitigation plan: hotpatch the route-resolver to check residency_required BEFORE considering cross-region fallback. I'll open PR and prepare a prod hotfix. Expect ~25m to patch + verify.
laura: Added audit_id=abc123 and full request trace to ticket TKT-45678 for compliance. Also captured packet-level timing for the failover window.
sam: Action items: (1) Emergency patch (dinesh) (2) Finance to review billing spike and prep correction (laura) (3) Customer comms + apology + rollback confirmation (maria). I'll own comms.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer message and coordinate with legal. ETA 1h.
laura: Billing note: observed 4x token billing spike for acct-987 between 11:59 and 12:10 UTC. Created finance incident FIN-789 and linked to TKT-45678.
support-bot: Linked entities: TKT-45678 -> FIN-789, audit_id=abc123, Ops incident INC-334.
